name: Boris
source:
A mysterious recluse artist living in the abandoned industrial town of Anomic.
He paints gloomy landscapes of decay and drowns his past in alcohol.
He meets Neon when she is looking for shelter. Despite his cynicism and apathy, he agrees to help her, seeing in her stubbornness echoes of someone he has lost.
